data.title: Rental agreement for Beispielweg 5, Musterstadt
data.case_title: Rental agreement with Wohnbau Musterstadt eG
data.summary: Wohnbau Musterstadt eG lets Sam Rivera a 2-room apartment (Wohnung Nr. 05-2-03) at Beispielweg 5, Musterstadt, starting 1 October 2025 for an indefinite term, at a total monthly rent of €640.00 (including €70 operating and €50 heating advance payments) plus a security deposit of €1,560.00.
data.explanation: This is your signed lease (Mietvertrag), not a letter needing a reply. The rent of €640.00 is due each month in advance, at the latest on the third working day of the month, to the landlord's account. You paid or still owe a security deposit of €1,560.00 (three months' net rent), payable in up to three instalments. The lease runs indefinitely; the notice period the app shows for ending it follows the statutory rule named in the contract (§ 573c BGB). Operating and heating cost advance payments are settled once a year, and the landlord may later send you a cost statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) with an additional payment or credit.

contract.name: Mietvertrag Wohnung Beispielweg 5
quotes: Das Mietverhältnis beginnt am 01.10.2025 und läuft auf unbestimmte Zeit.
Der Mieter kann das Mietverhältnis spätestens am dritten Werktag eines Kalendermonats zum Ablauf des übernächsten Monats kündigen (§ 573c Abs. 1 BGB).
Für die Kündigung durch die Vermieterin gelten die gesetzlichen Bestimmungen (§§ 573, 573c BGB).
